channel.title: IMR Case of the month
channel.description: One court decision on migrant workers each month, from the Institute for Migrant Rights.

item.title: Fishing crew are still migrant workers
item.description: Constitutional Court of Indonesia, Decision 127/PUU-XXI/2023, 29 November 2024. A petition asked the Constitutional Court to take ship crew and fishers out of Law 18/2017 on the Protection of Indonesian Migrant Workers. The Court rejected it. Indonesians who work on foreign fishing and merchant vessels remain migrant workers under Article 4(1)(c) of the Law, with the protection the Law gives before departure, while working abroad and after return.
